question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model/provider hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn through heartbeat.model and plugin hooks?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding this feature changes public task-file syntax, model precedence, and session-state behavior; automation should not choose that product/API contract.

options.title: Keep routing per-turn and plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks run as one model-routed turn and use heartbeat.model or before_model_resolve/ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields on task entries, fix parser handling for unknown indented fields, and split or group due tasks by effective model with regression coverage.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 as the canonical scheduled model override track and avoid a heartbeat-specific syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

recommendation.title: Keep routing per-turn and plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks run as one model-routed turn and use heartbeat.model or before_model_resolve/ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to both the heartbeat task-batching commit and the current before_model_resolve product seam, making him the best available owner for the core-vs-plugin contract choice.
